name: Necromancer: Command: Undead makes every one of four Ghouls cast Command: Ghouls (#1456)
contract: Raise: Ghoul 500971 reads 'Command: Expels leeching plague that strikes up to $801514i nearby enemies, dealing ... Plague damage, and healing you for ... for each Ghoul.' Command: Undead 504868 (family 29 word 2 0x1000000, the Command flag) reads 'Command your Undead minions to perform a unique attack on your target. Refer to individual Raise spells for their Command effect.' Command: Ghouls 801514 is one cast per Ghoul: effect 0 SCHOOL_DAMAGE and effect 1 on TARGET_UNIT_SRC_AREA_ENEMY within SpellRadius 13 = 10 yd of that Ghoul (up to 5 enemies), effect 2 HEAL on TARGET_UNIT_MASTER, so each Ghoul's cast carries its own damage and its own heal. The report saw two damage and two heal events with four Ghouls; the ordinary Life Force of 2 allows only two, so a fourth Ghoul needs two +1 Life Force passives (Summoning Adept 92123 and Scourge Apprentice Training 680283, each SPELLMOD_MAX_AURA_STACKS +1 on Life Force 805011). With a Life Force of 4 and four raised Ghouls (50073) beside a golem 4 yd away, one Command: Undead must produce exactly four Command: Ghouls casts from Ghouls and no more. SMSG_SPELL_GO is sent for 801514 because it has SpellVisual 1000256. This is evidence for behaviour that already works on current code; how the reporter reached a fourth Ghoul is not recorded.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and the Life Force aura settle
SETUP: two Life Force passives raise the capacity to 4
Let the Ghouls take their formation places
CONTROL: no Ghoul has cast Command: Ghouls before the order
Every one of the four Ghouls casts Command: Ghouls
Allow any extra cast to arrive
One order yields exactly one Command: Ghouls per Ghoul
All four Ghouls are still raised
